# ORCHESTRATED STEP
Run: **Project's Channel — M0 spine**
Step: **Mobile-first channel pass: bottom tabs, 9:16 rails, full-bleed player** (`channel-mobile`)

## Run objective
Build the load-bearing spine for the "Project's Channel" feature described in `design/project-channel.md` (read it first; it is the contract).

Scope of M0 only:
1. New python package `api/codx/junior/media/` with models (MediaJob, MediaAsset, EpisodeIR, RenderSpec, VoiceProfile, ProviderInfo), a `MediaProvider` protocol + registry, a job store under `<project>/.codx/media/` (inbox/jobs/episodes/assets), a cost/estimate budget gate, and a mandatory redaction entry point. Pure python, no network, unit-tested.
2. A background worker `media/worker.py` exposing `start_media_worker(stop_event)` / `stop_media_worker()` wired into `api/codx/junior/background.py` exactly like the existing wiki scheduler / orchestration worker (lazy import inside try/except, symmetric stop). Jobs must be persisted with leases + retries so a restart resumes work.
3. A FastAPI router `api/codx/junior/api/media.py` exposing `/api/media/providers`, `/api/media/queue`, `/api/media/episodes` (create/detail), `/api/media/assets/...`, following the conventions in `api/codx/junior/api/wiki.py`.
4. A local image provider PoC able to produce an episode cover with content-addressed caching (hash of provider+model+prompt+spec); ComfyUI is the real target but the provider must degrade to an available local/offline path when ComfyUI is not running.
5. Client shell: `/channel` view with tabs Home, Library (reusing `client/src/components/wiki/WikiMarkdown.vue` + `client/src/service/wiki.js`), Episodes, Shorts, Learn. The existing wiki nav entry becomes a tab inside the channel; existing `/wiki` routes must keep resolving.

Hard constraints:
- No external AI/media services in this milestone; local-first only.
- Do not break existing wiki behaviour or the existing background services.
- Keep changes reviewable; no reformatting of untouched code.
- Every new module gets tests where it is testable offline.

## Step objective
Take the working channel shell to mobile-first quality at 360px.

1. Bottom tab bar with safe-area inset (`env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`) on small screens, horizontal tabs at >= 768px; active state and >= 44px targets.
2. Shorts rail: snap-scroll horizontal list of 9:16 cards (`aspect-[9/16]`), one card per viewport slice, keyboard/pointer scrollable.
3. Episode player page/modal: full-bleed `playsinline` `<video>`, chapters list, transcript, and a mini-player that keeps playback position while the user browses Library/Home.
4. Tables and code blocks inside the wiki renderer scroll inside their own container (wrapper with `overflow-x-auto`), so the page never scrolls horizontally.

Acceptance is literal: no horizontal scroll at 360x640 and 390x844 (verify with the browser devtools responsive mode or a Playwright check if available), every interactive target >= 44px, one-handed reach for the tabs.

TIME BUDGET: at most 6 tool calls before writing. Do not add dependencies, do not restyle unrelated views. Verify with the client build and report the command.

## Acceptance criteria
No horizontal page scroll at 360x640 and 390x844, bottom tabs with safe area, 9:16 snap rail, mini-player preserves position across tab switches, build passes.

- `client/src/views/ChannelView.vue`

Product decision: mobile first. Depends on the Library tab being wired so the horizontal-scroll fix covers the wiki content too.

## What changed

**`client/src/views/ChannelView.vue`** — rewritten for 360 px first (structure per profile: imports in `<script setup>`, everything else Options API, Tailwind only, no `<style>`):

| Concern | Implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Tabs | Desktop keeps the horizontal bar (`hidden md:block`, ≥768 px); phones get a **bottom bar** (`md:hidden`) as the last flex child of the shell — no overlay, so panel content is never covered. Each target is `min-h-[56px] min-w-[44px]`, `flex-1`, icon+label, `aria-current="page"` on the active one. Safe area via `pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]`. |
| Reachability | Both bars are driven by the same `?tab=` query, so a tab is still a deep link; the bar sits in the lower third (one-handed). |
| Shorts rail | `snap-x snap-mandatory overflow-x-auto` list of `aspect-[9/16]` cards, `w-[72vw] max-w-[260px] snap-center` → one card per viewport slice. `tabindex="0"` + `role="list"` + `@keydown.left/right` scroll one card (`scrollRail`), pointer swipe is native. |
| Player | **One `<video>` element for the whole shell**, only re-styled by `stageClass` (full-bleed `fixed inset-0 aspect-video` when `?episode=` is set, 40×24 thumbnail above the tab bar otherwise, `hidden` when nothing is loaded) — it is never unmounted, so playback position survives every tab switch. `playsinline`, `preload="metadata"`, no `src` attribute until a real asset exists. |
| Player overlay | `fixed inset-0` sheet with an `aspect-video` spacer reserving the video area, then title, **chapters** list (44 px rows, click = `seekTo`) and **transcript** (with `mm:ss`), both with honest empty states ("appears once the episode is rendered"). Minimise keeps playing (mini-player), close frees the element. |
| Horizontal scroll | Root `overflow-x-hidden`; scroll panels are `overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden`; the Library tab stays `overflow-hidden` so `WikiView` owns its own scroll. |

**`client/src/components/wiki/WikiMarkdown.vue`** — new `wrapTables()` (called alongside `enhanceCodeBlocks()` from mount + text watch) wraps every rendered `<table>` in a `div.wiki-table-scroll` with `overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch`, and `table { margin: 0; min-width: max-content }` — a wide table scrolls **inside** itself, never the page. Code fences already had `overflow-x: auto` on `<pre>`. Video/wiki rendering is untouched otherwise.

**`client/src/router/index.ts`** — the `channel` route now passes `hideTabs: true` to `mobile()`: the channel owns the bottom bar, and stacking it on top of `MobileTabBar` would eat 56 px of a 640 px screen. `/wiki` and every existing route still resolve unchanged.

- `vite build` (production) inside the workspace container, exec 0, `✓ 5220 modules transformed`, no warnings on the new files:
